sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.7 "EXTI privilege configuration register (EXTI_PRIVCFGR1)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1138.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x018
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
This register provides privileged write access protection. An unprivileged write access is
discarded, and causes the generation of a privileged illegal access event. An unprivileged
read returns the register data.
Write to this register are ignored if GLOCK is enabled in EXTI_LOCKR.
This register contains only bits for security capable input events.
Bits 31:17 PRIVx: Privilege enable on event input x (x = 31 to 17)
0: Event privilege disabled (unprivileged)
1: Event privilege enabled (privileged)
l When SECx is disabled in EXT_SECCFGR1, PRIVx can be accessed with secure and
nonsecure access.
l When SECx is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, PRIVx can only be written with secure
access. Nonsecure write to PRIVx is discarded.
Bit 16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 PRIVx: Privilege enable on event input x (x = 15 to 0)
